name: Pray
take: Prayer isn't a wish list · it's keeping the LINE open with the One who runs everything · talk to Him like He's in the room, because He is
do: Set a 2-minute timer and just talk to Him out loud — no script, no fancy words
verse: Pray without ceasing.

name: Read the Word
take: His Word feeds a hunger food can't touch · skip a day and you feel it · it's not homework, it's a MEAL
do: Read one chapter — start with John 1 — and ask 'what does this show me about God?'
verse: Man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD.

name: Worship
take: Worship isn't a Sunday slot · it's an internal SOUNDTRACK you keep running · give Him the glory wherever you are
do: Put on one worship song and actually sing it — out loud, alone, like nobody's listening
verse: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him.

name: Fellowship
take: You weren't built to walk this solo · iron sharpens iron, but only when it's CLOSE enough to strike · find your people
do: Text one believer right now: 'how's your walk this week?' — and actually mean it
verse: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

name: Serve
take: Greatness in the kingdom wears an APRON · the King washed feet · you look most like Him doing the thing nobody claps for
do: Do one quiet thing for someone today that they can't pay back
verse: Even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister.

name: Give
take: Open hands don't EMPTY you · you got grace for nothing, so don't go hoarding it · generosity multiplies, hoarding shrinks
do: Give something away today — money, time, or a thing you've been gripping
verse: Freely ye have received, freely give.

name: Fast
take: Fasting tells your body who's BOSS · soul over stomach · you trade a craving you can see for a God you can't
do: Skip one thing today — a meal, a scroll, a snack — and pray each time you'd reach for it
verse: Turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping.

name: Rest (Sabbath)
take: Stopping is HOLY · the Sabbath was made for YOU, not you for it · rest is a gift God hands you, not laziness you steal
do: Block one hour today to do nothing 'productive' — and don't feel guilty about it
verse: The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath.

name: Confess & Repent
take: The SECOND you stop hiding it, He forgives it · confession and pardon happen almost in the same breath · turn and live
do: Name one thing to God plainly — no excuses — then thank Him it's already covered
verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins.

name: Memorize Scripture
take: Jesus fought the devil with the WORD, not cleverness · pack the sword now so it's there when you need it
do: Pick one short verse and say it 5 times out loud until it sticks
verse: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

name: Witness
take: You're just one beggar telling another where the BREAD is · sharing it isn't bragging, it's directions to the starving
do: Mention God naturally in one conversation today — your story, not a sermon
verse: Philip opened his mouth... and preached unto him Jesus.

name: Give Thanks
take: Gratitude is the natural END of seeing clearly · once you know where it all came from, you can't help but praise · count the mercies
do: Write down 3 specific things God did this week — get specific, not generic
verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

name: Obey
take: Love that OBEYS is the love that gets revealed · 'if you love Me, keep My commands' · the test of love is what you actually go DO
do: Think of one thing He's already told you to do — and do it today, no more stalling
verse: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

name: Forgive
take: Forgive the way He forgave YOU · that's the measuring stick · when you can't release someone, remember the size of the debt He dropped for you
do: Pick one person you're holding something against — and choose to release it today
verse: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another... even as Christ forgave you.

name: Get Baptized
take: Baptism BURIED the old you so you could come up walking new · it's a public 'I'm His' · don't live like the corpse you left in the water
do: If you've never been baptized, message a pastor today and ask about it
verse: We are buried with him by baptism into death: that... even so we also should walk in newness of life.

name: Take Communion
take: Communion is a REMEMBER button · the bread and cup drag your eyes back to the cross when life blurs it · He said 'do this in remembrance'
do: Next time it's offered, don't autopilot — actually pause and remember what it cost
verse: This is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

name: Be Still (Solitude)
take: Be STILL and know He's God · the stillness isn't doing nothing · it's finally letting Him be God instead of you white-knuckling it
do: Sit in silence for 3 minutes with no phone — just be with Him
verse: Be still, and know that I am God.

name: Encourage Others
take: Your words are construction EQUIPMENT · comfort and encouragement literally build people up · speak to add a floor, not knock one out
do: Send one specific, genuine encouragement to someone today — name what you see in them
verse: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another.

name: Endure Trials
take: The fire FORGES, it doesn't just burn · the test is building endurance in you · count it joy, because what you push through earns a crown
do: Name the hard thing you're in — then tell God 'I trust You in this' out loud
verse: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for... he shall receive the crown of life.

name: Examine Yourself
take: Check your OWN faith before inspecting everyone else's · 'search me, God' is braver than judging the room · self-examination keeps you honest
do: Ask God one question tonight: 'is there anything in me You want to deal with?' — then listen
verse: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts.

name: Walk Humbly
take: Go LOW to go up · whoever humbles himself gets exalted · let God hand out the promotion instead of grabbing it yourself
do: Today, let someone else be right — or take the lower seat on purpose
verse: What doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

name: Abide in Christ
take: A branch doesn't STRAIN to make fruit · it just stays connected to the vine · stay close to Jesus and the fruit takes care of itself
do: Build one tiny 'with Him' moment into your day — coffee, commute, whatever — and keep it
verse: I am the vine, ye are the branches: he that abideth in me... bringeth forth much fruit.

name: Pray for Your Enemies
take: Jesus raised the bar past tolerance to LOVE · bless the ones who curse you, pray for the ones who use you · it frees YOU before it changes them
do: Pray one genuine blessing over someone who's wronged you — say their name to God
verse: Love your enemies, bless them that curse you... and pray for them which despitefully use you.

name: Practice Hospitality
take: Open your DOOR, not just your wallet · the kingdom runs on tables, not just transactions · some angels showed up as strangers
do: Invite someone in this week — a meal, a coffee, a 'come hang' — especially someone overlooked
verse: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

name: Make Peace
take: Reconciliation comes BEFORE religion · if a brother's got something against you, fix THAT before you bring your gift · God wants you right with people
do: Reach out to the one relationship that's been off — make the first move today
verse: First be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

name: Keep Your Word
take: Let your yes be YES and your no be no · be the kind of person whose plain word holds up · so you never need to swear to be believed
do: Follow through on one thing you said you'd do but haven't — close the loop today
verse: Let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay.

name: Flee Temptation
take: Some battles you don't FIGHT, you flee · Joseph ran, he didn't negotiate · run FROM the trap and run TOWARD better company
do: Name your usual trap — then set up one guardrail today that makes it harder to fall in
verse: Flee fornication.

name: Be Content
take: Godliness PLUS contentment is the real jackpot · chasing more never reaches 'enough' · the goalpost slides forever, so plant your flag now
do: List 3 things you already have that you've been treating like they're not enough
verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

name: Guard Your Heart
take: Guard your heart above EVERYTHING · every direction your life flows starts in there · watch what you let take up residence
do: Cut one input today that's been feeding the wrong stuff — a feed, a show, a voice
verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

name: Speak Life
take: Death and life are in the TONGUE · your words either build a floor or knock one out · pick life, on purpose, today
do: Catch one negative thing before it leaves your mouth — and say something true and kind instead
verse: Death and life are in the power of the tongue.

name: Wait on God
take: Waiting is an ASSIGNMENT, not an accident · those who wait on Him swap their gas tank for His · renewed strength, soaring not stalling
do: Bring God the thing you're rushing — and tell Him 'I'll wait for Your timing on this one'
verse: They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.

name: Lament Honestly
take: You can bring God the RAW version · pour your heart out like water · honest grief isn't a lack of faith, it's faith being real
do: Tell God exactly how you feel about a hard thing — unfiltered — and don't tidy it up first
verse: Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us.

name: Disciple Someone
take: Faith is a RELAY, not a solo · what you've learned, hand to someone who'll hand it on · pour into the next person down the line
do: Pick one person younger in the faith — and intentionally pour one thing into them this week
verse: The same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

name: Remember (Ebenezer)
take: Mark the places He CARRIED you · Samuel set up a stone meaning 'this far the Lord has helped us' · remember on purpose, or you'll forget on accident
do: Write down one specific time God came through for you — and keep it where you'll see it
verse: Samuel... called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
